Needs Android 11 or newer. VSpace activates its own shell-uid helper through Wireless Debugging, which is an Android 11+ feature.
Enable Wireless Debugging in Developer options, then return — VSpace will reconnect automatically.
In Wireless Debugging on this phone, tap “Pair device with a pairing code”, then enter the 6 digits below. VSpace pairs once; the device trusts it thereafter.
Connecting to the local ADB service…
Pairing failed — check the code and that the “Pair device” dialog is still open, then try again.
Could not find the pairing service — open “Pair device with a pairing code” in Wireless Debugging first.
Glasses connected — tap apps to add screens (up to 3).
Connect your VITURE glasses to open the workspace.
Finish wireless-debugging pairing first — see the banner above.
